title: How to clean the drain pump filter
subtitle: Electrolux PerfectCare 700, 9 kg — EW7F7649U2

steps.caption: Clean the drain pump filter
steps.narration: The drain pump filter is behind the round hatch at the bottom right.

cue.why: camera moves to the hatch as 'round hatch' is spoken (measured from the narration's loudness)

steps.caption: Unplug and prepare for water
steps.narration: Switch off, unplug, and let hot water cool. Have a towel and shallow container ready: water may run out.

steps.caption: Open, lower, and place container
steps.narration: Open the hatch and lower the drain guide. Place the shallow container underneath before turning the filter.

steps.caption: Loosen slightly and catch water
steps.narration: Turn the filter slightly anticlockwise, without removing it. Water runs down the guide and fills the container.

steps.caption: Stop water, empty, and return
steps.narration: When nearly full, tighten the filter clockwise to stop the water. Take the container away, empty it, and put it back.

steps.caption: Drain the remaining water
steps.narration: Loosen slightly again and let the remaining water drain until it stops. Repeat the emptying cycle if needed.

steps.caption: Unscrew and remove the filter
steps.narration: Only after the water stops, unscrew the filter anticlockwise and pull it out.

steps.caption: Remove lint and loose objects
steps.narration: Remove lint and loose objects from the filter basket.

steps.caption: Refit clockwise and close up
steps.narration: Refit the filter and tighten clockwise until secure. Fold the guide up, close the hatch, and empty the container.

steps.caption: Filter cleaned and hatch closed
steps.narration: The filter is clean and everything is back in place.
